$comment: Single source of truth for the curriculum. Discipline and topic folders, their order, level and one-line description. tools/build_indexes.py generates every index file from this manifest; tools/validate_repo.py checks the result.

disciplines.title: Foundations
disciplines.subtitle: How mathematics itself works
disciplines.blurb: Mathematical thinking, logic, sets, proof and the language of functions. These are not prerequisites you finish once: they are the grammar that every later subject is written in.

topics.title: Mathematical Thinking and Problem Solving
topics.blurb: Abstraction, conjecture, counterexample and the heuristics of solving unfamiliar problems.

topics.title: Propositional and First-Order Logic
topics.blurb: Connectives, truth tables, quantifiers, inference rules and the anatomy of a valid argument.

topics.title: Set Theory
topics.blurb: Sets, operations, identities, cardinality and Cantor's diagonal argument.

topics.title: Proof Techniques
topics.blurb: Direct proof, contraposition, contradiction, cases, existence and uniqueness.

topics.title: Relations and Functions
topics.blurb: Ordered pairs, equivalence relations, orders, injections, surjections and bijections.

disciplines.title: Arithmetic
disciplines.subtitle: Number and operation from the ground up
disciplines.blurb: Counting, the integers, fractions, decimals, percentages, ratios and powers. Arithmetic is not a preliminary to mathematics; it is where the number systems are built, and every later subject leans on it.

topics.title: Natural Numbers
topics.blurb: Place value, the operations and their properties, primes, GCD and LCM, other bases.

topics.title: Integers and Negative Numbers
topics.blurb: Signed numbers, absolute value and the real reason negative times negative is positive.

topics.title: Fractions
topics.blurb: Fractions as numbers, equivalent forms, the four operations and why the rules work.

topics.title: Decimals
topics.blurb: Place value beyond the point, repeating decimals, rounding, scientific notation.

topics.title: Percentages
topics.blurb: Percent as a ratio, increases and decreases, successive changes, reverse percentages.

topics.title: Ratios, Rates and Proportions
topics.blurb: Comparison, unit rates, proportional reasoning, scaling and dimensional analysis.

topics.title: Exponents and Roots
topics.blurb: The exponent laws and their proofs, radicals, rational exponents, irrationality.

disciplines.title: Pre-Algebra
disciplines.subtitle: The bridge from numbers to symbols
disciplines.blurb: Order of operations, variables, factors, first equations and the coordinate plane. This is the shortest and most important bridge in the curriculum: after it, arithmetic becomes algebra.

topics.title: Order of Operations
topics.blurb: Why a convention is needed, precedence, grouping symbols and evaluation.

topics.title: Variables and Algebraic Expressions
topics.blurb: Letters as unknowns, translating words, terms, like terms, distributivity.

topics.title: Factors, Multiples, GCD and LCM
topics.blurb: Divisibility rules, prime factorisation, the Euclidean algorithm and its uses.

topics.title: Introduction to Equations
topics.blurb: The balance model, inverse operations and solving one- and two-step equations.

topics.title: The Coordinate Plane
topics.blurb: Coordinates, distance, midpoint, slope and the graph of a relationship.

disciplines.title: Algebra
disciplines.subtitle: Symbolic reasoning and the study of structure
disciplines.blurb: From linear equations to complex numbers. Algebra teaches you to reason about whole classes of quantities at once, and it is the language in which geometry, calculus and everything after it is written.

topics.title: Elementary Algebra
topics.blurb: Expressions, the field properties, simplification, formulas and modelling.

topics.title: Linear Equations
topics.blurb: Solving with justification, fractional coefficients, absolute value, applications.

topics.title: Inequalities
topics.blurb: Order axioms, interval notation, absolute-value inequalities and sign charts.

topics.title: Intermediate Algebra
topics.blurb: Rational exponents, radicals, rational expressions, division and the binomial theorem.

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations
topics.blurb: Substitution, elimination, three variables and the geometry of solution sets.

topics.title: Polynomials
topics.blurb: Degree, arithmetic, end behaviour, the division algorithm and Vieta's formulas.

topics.title: Factoring
topics.blurb: Common factors, grouping, quadratics, special forms and general strategies.

topics.title: Quadratic Equations
topics.blurb: Four solving methods, completing the square, the discriminant and the vertex form.

topics.title: Rational Expressions
topics.blurb: Domains, simplification, LCD arithmetic, complex fractions and rational equations.

topics.title: Radicals and Rational Exponents
topics.blurb: Root laws, simplification, conjugates, radical equations and extraneous roots.

topics.title: Functions
topics.blurb: Domain, range, graphs, transformations, composition, inverses and families.

topics.title: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
topics.blurb: Exponential growth, the number e, logarithms as inverses and their laws.

topics.title: Complex Numbers
topics.blurb: The complex plane, arithmetic, conjugates, polar form and roots of unity.

topics.title: Advanced Algebra
topics.blurb: Polynomial equations, the fundamental theorem of algebra, partial fractions, sequences.

disciplines.title: Geometry
disciplines.subtitle: Shape, space and rigorous deduction
disciplines.blurb: Euclid's axiomatic method is the ancestor of all mathematics. From congruent triangles to coordinates, transformations and non-Euclidean spaces, geometry is where proof becomes visible.

topics.title: Euclidean Geometry
topics.blurb: Axioms, postulates, angles, parallel lines, and geometry as a deductive system.

topics.title: Triangles
topics.blurb: Congruence, similarity, the Pythagorean theorem, area and triangle centres.

topics.title: Circles
topics.blurb: Chords, tangents, inscribed angles, power of a point and circle theorems.

topics.title: Coordinate Geometry
topics.blurb: Lines, distance, midpoint, slope, and algebraic proofs of geometric facts.

topics.title: Solid Geometry
topics.blurb: Polyhedra, spheres, cylinders, cones, volume, surface area and cross-sections.

topics.title: Geometric Transformations
topics.blurb: Isometries, dilations, composition, symmetry groups and tessellations.

topics.title: Analytic Geometry
topics.blurb: Conic sections from the focus-directrix definition and their equations.

topics.title: Non-Euclidean Geometry
topics.blurb: The parallel postulate, spherical and hyperbolic geometry, curvature.

disciplines.title: Trigonometry
disciplines.subtitle: Angles, circles and periodic phenomena
disciplines.blurb: Trigonometry begins with right triangles and ends as the study of the functions that model every oscillation in nature. The unit circle is the bridge between the two.

topics.title: Trigonometric Functions
topics.blurb: Right-triangle ratios, sine, cosine, tangent, exact values and applications.

topics.title: The Unit Circle and Radian Measure
topics.blurb: Radians, arc length, the unit circle definition, periodicity and graphs.

topics.title: Trigonometric Identities
topics.blurb: Pythagorean, sum, double-angle and half-angle identities, with proofs.

topics.title: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
topics.blurb: Principal branches, domains, graphs and solving trigonometric equations.

topics.title: Triangle Trigonometry
topics.blurb: The laws of sines and cosines, the ambiguous case and surveying problems.

topics.title: Trigonometric Equations
topics.blurb: General solutions, periodicity, substitutions and modelling with sinusoids.

disciplines.title: Precalculus
disciplines.subtitle: The functions and tools that calculus needs
disciplines.blurb: A focused preparation for calculus: function families, transformations, sequences and series, conics, and an honest first look at limits.

topics.title: Functions and Graphs
topics.blurb: Function notation, domains, transformations, composition, inverses and rates.

topics.title: Polynomial and Rational Functions
topics.blurb: Roots, multiplicity, asymptotes, end behaviour and inequality sign charts.

topics.title: Exponential and Logarithmic Models
topics.blurb: Growth and decay, half-life, log scales, and fitting exponential data.

topics.title: Conic Sections
topics.blurb: Circles, parabolas, ellipses and hyperbolas as loci and as equations.

topics.title: Sequences and Series
topics.blurb: Arithmetic and geometric sequences, summation notation, induction, convergence.

topics.title: Introduction to Limits
topics.blurb: Average and instantaneous rate of change, limit intuition and the tangent problem.

disciplines.title: Calculus
disciplines.subtitle: Change, accumulation and the link between them
disciplines.blurb: The derivative measures change; the integral measures accumulation; the fundamental theorem says they are inverse. Calculus turns geometry into algebra and motion into equations.

topics.title: Limits
topics.blurb: Epsilon-delta, one-sided limits, limit laws, indeterminate forms and asymptotes.

topics.title: Continuity
topics.blurb: Definition, types of discontinuity, the intermediate and extreme value theorems.

topics.title: Derivatives
topics.blurb: The derivative as a limit, differentiability, tangent lines and rates of change.

topics.title: Differentiation Rules
topics.blurb: Product, quotient, chain and implicit differentiation, with proofs.

topics.title: Applications of Derivatives
topics.blurb: Extrema, the mean value theorem, curve sketching, related rates, optimization.

topics.title: Integrals
topics.blurb: Riemann sums, the definite integral, area and the integral as accumulation.

topics.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
topics.blurb: Both parts, their proofs, and why differentiation and integration are inverse.

topics.title: Techniques of Integration
topics.blurb: Substitution, parts, partial fractions, trigonometric substitution and numerics.

topics.title: Applications of Integration
topics.blurb: Volumes, arc length, averages, work, and probability density functions.

topics.title: Improper Integrals
topics.blurb: Unbounded intervals and integrands, convergence tests and comparison.

topics.title: Sequences and Series
topics.blurb: Convergence tests, power series, Taylor series and error estimates.

topics.title: Multivariable Calculus
topics.blurb: Partial derivatives, gradients, multiple integrals, Lagrange multipliers.

topics.title: Vector Calculus
topics.blurb: Vector fields, line and surface integrals, Green, Stokes and Gauss theorems.

disciplines.title: Linear Algebra
disciplines.subtitle: Vectors, matrices and linear structure
disciplines.blurb: Linear algebra is the most widely applied subject in mathematics: geometry, differential equations, statistics, physics, machine learning and abstract algebra all run on it.

topics.title: Vectors
topics.blurb: Geometric and algebraic vectors, dot and cross products, projections.

topics.title: Matrices
topics.blurb: Matrix algebra, multiplication as composition, inverses, transpose, rank.

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations
topics.blurb: Gaussian elimination, row reduction, solution structure and LU factorisation.

topics.title: Vector Spaces
topics.blurb: Axioms, subspaces, span, independence, bases, dimension and coordinates.

topics.title: Linear Transformations
topics.blurb: Matrices as maps, kernel and image, rank-nullity, change of basis.

topics.title: Determinants
topics.blurb: Volume interpretation, properties, cofactor expansion and Cramer's rule.

topics.title: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
topics.blurb: Characteristic polynomials, diagonalisation, spectral theorem, applications.

topics.title: Inner Product Spaces
topics.blurb: Orthogonality, Gram-Schmidt, projections, least squares and Fourier ideas.

disciplines.title: Discrete Mathematics
disciplines.subtitle: Induction, algorithms and finite structures
disciplines.blurb: The mathematics of computer science and of counting: induction, recurrences, complexity, logic circuits and discrete probability.

topics.title: Mathematical Induction
topics.blurb: Weak and strong induction, well-ordering, and writing induction proofs.

topics.title: Recurrence Relations
topics.blurb: Iteration, characteristic equations, master theorem and divide-and-conquer.

topics.title: Algorithms and Complexity
topics.blurb: Big-O, growth rates, sorting bounds, P vs NP and computability preview.

topics.title: Boolean Algebra
topics.blurb: Boolean laws, normal forms, Karnaugh maps and logic circuits.

topics.title: Discrete Probability
topics.blurb: Finite sample spaces, counting with probability, expectation and variance.

disciplines.title: Probability
disciplines.subtitle: Uncertainty made rigorous
disciplines.blurb: From coin flips to measure-theoretic foundations, probability is the mathematics of uncertainty and the foundation of statistics, physics and machine learning.

topics.title: Probability Foundations
topics.blurb: Sample spaces, axioms, inclusion-exclusion, counting and conditional probability.

topics.title: Conditional Probability and Independence
topics.blurb: Bayes' theorem, independence, the base-rate fallacy and Markov chains.

topics.title: Random Variables
topics.blurb: Discrete and continuous variables, PMFs, PDFs, CDFs and transformations.

topics.title: Probability Distributions
topics.blurb: Binomial, Poisson, geometric, normal, exponential, gamma and friends.

topics.title: Expectation and Variance
topics.blurb: Linearity, moments, generating functions, covariance and inequalities.

topics.title: Law of Large Numbers and the Central Limit Theorem
topics.blurb: Modes of convergence and why the normal distribution is universal.

topics.title: Stochastic Processes
topics.blurb: Markov chains, Poisson processes, random walks, martingales and Brownian motion.

disciplines.title: Statistics
disciplines.subtitle: Learning from data
disciplines.blurb: Descriptive statistics, estimation, hypothesis testing, regression and Bayesian inference: the part of probability that turns data into decisions.

topics.title: Descriptive Statistics
topics.blurb: Means, medians, spread, quartiles, outliers and honest data visualisation.

topics.title: Sampling and Estimation
topics.blurb: Sampling distributions, standard error, confidence intervals and bias.

topics.title: Hypothesis Testing
topics.blurb: Null models, p-values, t-tests, power, multiplicity and common misuses.

topics.title: Linear Regression
topics.blurb: Least squares, inference for coefficients, residuals and model checking.

topics.title: Bayesian Statistics
topics.blurb: Priors, posteriors, conjugacy, credible intervals and Bayesian computation.

topics.title: Experimental Design
topics.blurb: Randomisation, blocking, confounding, causal inference and Simpson's paradox.

disciplines.title: Number Theory
disciplines.subtitle: The integers and their hidden structure
disciplines.blurb: Divisibility, primes, congruences and Diophantine equations. Elementary to state, deep to prove, and the historical engine of algebraic abstraction.

topics.title: Divisibility and Primes
topics.blurb: The division algorithm, the Euclidean algorithm, uniqueness of factorisation.

topics.title: Congruences
topics.blurb: Modular arithmetic, the Chinese remainder theorem, Euler and Fermat.

topics.title: Arithmetic Functions
topics.blurb: Divisor functions, Möbius inversion, Euler's totient and multiplicativity.

topics.title: Diophantine Equations
topics.blurb: Linear equations, Pell's equation, Pythagorean triples and Fermat's method.

topics.title: Quadratic Residues and Reciprocity
topics.blurb: Legendre symbols, Gauss's lemma and the law of quadratic reciprocity.

topics.title: Analytic Number Theory
topics.blurb: The prime number theorem, Dirichlet series, the zeta function and primes.

disciplines.title: Abstract Algebra
disciplines.subtitle: Structure for its own sake
disciplines.blurb: Groups, rings and fields: the axiomatic study of algebraic structure, culminating in Galois theory and the impossibility of solving the quintic by radicals.

topics.title: Groups
topics.blurb: Axioms, subgroups, cosets, Lagrange's theorem, homomorphisms and quotients.

topics.title: Rings
topics.blurb: Ideals, quotient rings, integral domains, polynomial rings and UFDs.

topics.title: Fields
topics.blurb: Field extensions, finite fields, algebraic and transcendental elements.

topics.title: Galois Theory
topics.blurb: Galois groups, the fundamental theorem, solvability and the quintic.

topics.title: Modules
topics.blurb: Modules over rings, free modules, structure theory and exact sequences.

disciplines.title: Real Analysis
disciplines.subtitle: Calculus made rigorous
disciplines.blurb: Completeness, limits, continuity, differentiation, integration and metric spaces. The subject where you learn why the theorems of calculus are true — and when they fail.

topics.title: The Real Numbers and Completeness
topics.blurb: Ordered fields, supremum, Dedekind cuts and Cantor's construction.

topics.title: Sequences and Series
topics.blurb: Convergence, subsequences, Cauchy sequences and absolute convergence.

topics.title: Continuity and Limits
topics.blurb: Epsilon-delta, compactness arguments and the intermediate value theorem.

topics.title: Differentiation
topics.blurb: The derivative, the mean value theorem, Taylor's theorem and convexity.

topics.title: Riemann Integration
topics.blurb: Partitions, the Riemann criterion, the fundamental theorem and improper integrals.

topics.title: Metric Spaces
topics.blurb: Open and closed sets, completeness, compactness and the contraction principle.

disciplines.title: Complex Analysis
disciplines.subtitle: Calculus in the complex plane
disciplines.blurb: Complex differentiability is far stronger than real differentiability, and the consequences — Cauchy's theorem, power series, residues — are astonishingly powerful.

topics.title: Complex Numbers and Geometry
topics.blurb: Arithmetic, polar form, Möbius maps and the geometry of the complex plane.

topics.title: Analytic Functions
topics.blurb: Holomorphy, the Cauchy-Riemann equations and harmonic functions.

topics.title: Complex Integration
topics.blurb: Contour integrals, Cauchy's theorem and formula, Liouville and Morera.

topics.title: Power Series and Residues
topics.blurb: Laurent series, singularities, the residue theorem and integral evaluation.

topics.title: Conformal Mappings
topics.blurb: Conformality, fractional linear maps, the Riemann mapping theorem.

disciplines.title: Differential Equations
disciplines.subtitle: Modelling how things change
disciplines.blurb: The language of physics, engineering, biology and economics. From separable equations to PDEs and Laplace transforms.

topics.title: First-Order Differential Equations
topics.blurb: Separable, linear and exact equations, integrating factors and modelling.

topics.title: Second-Order Linear ODEs
topics.blurb: Characteristic equations, undetermined coefficients, resonance and oscillations.

topics.title: Systems of ODEs
topics.blurb: Matrix methods, phase portraits, stability and linearisation.

topics.title: Laplace Transforms
topics.blurb: Transform rules, inverse transforms, convolution and discontinuous forcing.

topics.title: Introduction to PDEs
topics.blurb: The heat, wave and Laplace equations, separation of variables, Fourier series.

topics.title: Numerical Solutions of ODEs
topics.blurb: Euler, Runge-Kutta, stability, stiffness and error control.

disciplines.title: Topology
disciplines.subtitle: Continuity without distance
disciplines.blurb: Open sets, compactness, connectedness and the classification of spaces. Topology is geometry stripped to its essential structure.

topics.title: Topological Spaces
topics.blurb: Open sets, bases, subspaces, quotient and product topologies, separation.

topics.title: Continuity and Homeomorphisms
topics.blurb: Continuity via preimages, homeomorphism, invariance of topological properties.

topics.title: Compactness
topics.blurb: Open covers, Heine-Borel, sequential compactness, Tychonoff's theorem.

topics.title: Connectedness
topics.blurb: Connected and path-connected spaces, components and the intermediate value theorem.

topics.title: Introduction to Algebraic Topology
topics.blurb: Homotopy, the fundamental group, covering spaces and Euler characteristic.

disciplines.title: Optimization
disciplines.subtitle: Finding the best answer
disciplines.blurb: Linear programming, convexity, Lagrange multipliers and gradient methods: the mathematics behind scheduling, engineering design and machine learning.

topics.title: Linear Programming
topics.blurb: Feasible regions, the simplex method, duality and sensitivity.

topics.title: Convex Optimization
topics.blurb: Convex sets and functions, duality, KKT conditions and optimality certificates.

topics.title: Lagrange Multipliers
topics.blurb: Equality and inequality constraints, the geometry behind the multiplier.

topics.title: Gradient Methods
topics.blurb: Gradient descent, convergence rates, stochastic and accelerated variants.

disciplines.title: Numerical Analysis
disciplines.subtitle: Mathematics that runs on a computer
disciplines.blurb: Floating point, root finding, interpolation, numerical integration and iterative solvers — plus the error analysis that says whether an answer can be trusted.

topics.title: Floating-Point Arithmetic
topics.blurb: IEEE 754, rounding error, catastrophic cancellation and condition numbers.

topics.title: Root Finding
topics.blurb: Bisection, Newton, secant and fixed-point iteration with convergence orders.

topics.title: Interpolation and Approximation
topics.blurb: Lagrange and Newton forms, splines, least squares and Runge's phenomenon.

topics.title: Numerical Integration
topics.blurb: Trapezoid, Simpson, Gaussian quadrature and error bounds.

topics.title: Iterative Methods for Linear Systems
topics.blurb: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, conjugate gradients and condition numbers.

disciplines.title: Combinatorics
disciplines.subtitle: Counting, arranging and extremal structure
disciplines.blurb: The art of counting without listing: bijections, inclusion-exclusion, generating functions and extremal arguments.

topics.title: Counting Principles
topics.blurb: Product and sum rules, permutations, combinations, bijective proofs.

topics.title: Inclusion-Exclusion
topics.blurb: The principle, its proof, derangements and applications to counting.

topics.title: The Pigeonhole Principle
topics.blurb: Basic and generalised forms, with classic and surprising applications.

topics.title: Generating Functions
topics.blurb: Ordinary and exponential generating functions as algebraic counters.

topics.title: Partitions and Compositions
topics.blurb: Integer partitions, Ferrers diagrams, Euler's pentagonal theorem preview.

topics.title: Extremal Combinatorics
topics.blurb: Turán's theorem, Ramsey theory, matching and the probabilistic method.

disciplines.title: Graph Theory
disciplines.subtitle: Networks, connectivity and optimisation on them
disciplines.blurb: Graphs model everything from road networks to social networks. Trees, connectivity, colouring, flows and spectra.

topics.title: Graph Basics
topics.blurb: Vertices, edges, degree, isomorphism, handshake lemma, adjacency matrices.

topics.title: Trees
topics.blurb: Characterisations, spanning trees, Kruskal and Prim, Cayley's formula.

topics.title: Paths and Connectivity
topics.blurb: Euler and Hamilton paths, shortest paths, Menger's theorem and cuts.

topics.title: Planarity and Colouring
topics.blurb: Euler's formula, Kuratowski's theorem, chromatic number and the four-colour theorem.

topics.title: Matching and Flows
topics.blurb: Bipartite matching, Hall's theorem, max-flow min-cut and applications.

topics.title: Spectral Graph Theory
topics.blurb: Adjacency and Laplacian spectra, Cheeger inequality, random walks.

disciplines.title: Mathematical Modeling
disciplines.subtitle: Turning the real world into equations
disciplines.blurb: How to build, validate and criticise a model: population dynamics, epidemics, optimisation and stochastic simulation.

topics.title: Principles of Modeling
topics.blurb: Abstraction, assumptions, dimensional analysis, validation and model limits.

topics.title: Population Dynamics
topics.blurb: Exponential and logistic growth, harvesting, predator-prey systems.

topics.title: Epidemic Models
topics.blurb: SIR and SEIR, R0, herd immunity and parameter estimation.

topics.title: Optimization Models
topics.blurb: Formulating real problems as linear and integer programs.

topics.title: Stochastic Models
topics.blurb: Monte Carlo simulation, queueing, random walks and risk.

disciplines.title: Applied Mathematics
disciplines.subtitle: Mathematics in the physical and social world
disciplines.blurb: Mathematical physics, information theory, game theory, finance, control and signal processing: the payoff of everything above.

topics.title: Mathematical Physics
topics.blurb: Classical mechanics in Lagrangian form, waves, and energy methods.

topics.title: Information Theory
topics.blurb: Entropy, mutual information, source coding and channel capacity.

topics.title: Game Theory
topics.blurb: Nash equilibria, mixed strategies, cooperative games and mechanism design.

topics.title: Financial Mathematics
topics.blurb: Interest, present value, portfolio theory, options and risk-neutral pricing.

topics.title: Control Theory
topics.blurb: State space models, stability, feedback, controllability and observability.

topics.title: Signal Processing
topics.blurb: Fourier series and transforms, sampling, filters and convolution.

disciplines.title: Advanced Topics
disciplines.subtitle: Research-level foundations
disciplines.blurb: Measure theory, functional analysis, category theory, differential and algebraic geometry, dynamical systems and more: the door from undergraduate mathematics into research.

topics.title: Measure Theory
topics.blurb: Sigma-algebras, Lebesgue measure, measurable functions and integration.

topics.title: Functional Analysis
topics.blurb: Banach and Hilbert spaces, bounded operators, Hahn-Banach and spectral theory.

topics.title: Category Theory
topics.blurb: Categories, functors, natural transformations, limits and adjunctions.

topics.title: Differential Geometry
topics.blurb: Manifolds, tangent spaces, differential forms, connections and curvature.

topics.title: Algebraic Topology
topics.blurb: Homology, cohomology, exact sequences and topological invariants.

topics.title: Algebraic Geometry
topics.blurb: Affine and projective varieties, ideals, schemes and Bézout's theorem.

topics.title: Dynamical Systems and Chaos
topics.blurb: Flows, maps, fixed points, bifurcations, chaos and the logistic map.

topics.title: Representation Theory
topics.blurb: Group actions on vector spaces, characters and the Peter-Weyl idea.

topics.title: Commutative Algebra
topics.blurb: Localisation, Noetherian rings, primary decomposition and dimension theory.

topics.title: Model Theory
topics.blurb: Languages, structures, compactness, Löwenheim-Skolem and quantifier elimination.

topics.title: Computability and Decidability
topics.blurb: Turing machines, the halting problem, Gödel's incompleteness theorems.

topics.title: Algebraic Number Theory
topics.blurb: Number fields, rings of integers, ideals, unique factorisation and units.

topics.title: Homological Algebra
topics.blurb: Chain complexes, exact sequences, derived functors and spectral sequences.
